statement:
∀ (A k : ℕ), 0 < k →
 (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ i : Fin n, -(A : ℝ) < x i ∧ x i < A) →
 let U : (Fin n → Fin (2 * A * k)) → Set (YuiEucl n) := fun f =>
   WithLp.toLp 2 '' (Set.pi Set.univ fun i : Fin n =>
     Set.Icc (-(A : ℝ) + (f i : ℝ) / k)
       (-(A : ℝ) + ((f i : ℝ) + 1) / k))
 E ⊆ ⋃ f, U f ∧
 ∀ f, Metric.ediam (U f) ≤
   (((n : ℝ≥0) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞)).toReal : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) * (1 / (k : ℝ≥0∞))
proof:
classical
intro A k hk hE
dsimp only
constructor
· intro x hx
  have kpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk
  let f : Fin n → Fin (2 * A * k) := fun i =>
    ⟨⌊(x i + (A : ℝ)) * k⌋₊, by
      apply (@yui_aux_0003 n E h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T002).1 _ _
        (mul_nonneg (by linarith [(hE x hx i).1]) kpos.le)
      have hi := (hE x hx i).2
      have hlt : (x i + (A : ℝ)) * k < (2 * A : ℝ) * k :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) kpos
      exact_mod_cast hlt⟩
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨f, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨WithLp.ofLp x, ?_, (@yui_aux_0003 n E h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T002).2 x⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_univ_pi, Set.mem_Icc]
  intro i
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (x i + (A : ℝ)) * k :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith [(hE x hx i).1]) kpos.le
  change -(A : ℝ) + (⌊(x i + (A : ℝ)) * k⌋₊ : ℝ) / k ≤ x i ∧
    x i ≤ -(A : ℝ) + ((⌊(x i + (A : ℝ)) * k⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) / k
  constructor
  · have hfloor := Nat.floor_le hnonneg
    have hd := (div_le_iff₀ kpos).mpr hfloor
    nlinarith
  · have hfloor := (Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((x i + (A : ℝ)) * k)).le
    have hd := (le_div_iff₀ kpos).mpr hfloor
    nlinarith
· intro f
  have hLip := PiLp.lipschitzWith_toLp (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞)) (β := fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)
  have hdiam := hLip.ediam_image_le
    (Set.pi Set.univ fun i : Fin n =>
      Set.Icc (-(A : ℝ) + (f i : ℝ) / k)
        (-(A : ℝ) + ((f i : ℝ) + 1) / k))
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hdiam
  refine hdiam.trans (mul_le_mul_left' ?_ _)
  apply Metric.ediam_pi_le_of_le
  intro i
  rw [Real.ediam_Icc]
  have heq : -(A : ℝ) + ((f i : ℝ) + 1) / k -
      (-(A : ℝ) + (f i : ℝ) / k) = 1 / k := by ring
  rw [heq, ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk)]
  simp

  0 ≤ n →
    E.Nonempty →
      IsCompact E →
        ((∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (a : ℝ),
              0 < a →
                YuiMeasure a A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a) A ∧
                  (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal a → YuiMeasure a A = 0) ∧
                    (ENNReal.ofReal a < dimH A → YuiMeasure a A = ∞) ∧
                      (YuiMeasure a A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a) ∧
                        (YuiMeasure a A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ dimH A)) ∧
            (∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)), 0 ≤ dimH A) ∧
              (∀ (k : ℕ) (A B : Set (YuiEucl k)), A ⊆ B → dimH A ≤ dimH B) ∧
                ∀ (k l : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (g : ↑A → YuiEucl l), Isometry g → dimH (Set.range g) = dimH A) →
          ∀ (A k : ℕ),
            0 < k →
              (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (i : Fin n), -↑A < x.ofLp i ∧ x.ofLp i < ↑A) →
                have U := fun f =>
                  WithLp.toLp 2 '' Set.univ.pi fun i => Set.Icc (-↑A + ↑↑(f i) / ↑k) (-↑A + (↑↑(f i) + 1) / ↑k);
                E ⊆ ⋃ f, U f ∧ ∀ (f : Fin n → Fin (2 * A * k)), Metric.ediam (U f) ≤ ↑(↑n ^ (1 / 2).toReal) * (1 / ↑k)
